raw: Before breakfast I feed the sparrows. I scoop the sunflower seeds out of the tin for them, and I pour fresh water into the birdbath. That’s something I do every day. The water makes me think of work—I’m a swimming pool caretaker, so water is part of my day there too, though a birdbath is a different sort of thing. But you were asking about mornings. It’s the sparrows first, getting their seeds out and making sure there’s fresh water, and then I have my breakfast.
